name: Ikuya Mitty
author: Ikuya Kirishima
description: P1–P5 from Ikuya Kirishima’s mitigation plan. Choose a tank position, healer job, or DPS position.

MT.name: Party Mit (GNB/DRK)
MT.note: Time this to carry over through Wave Cannon and the first Double-Trouble Trap.

OT.name: Party Mit
OT.note: Use your 90s party mitigation as Kefka re-centres to cast the first Graven Image (WAR/PLD can use after Revolting Ruin III finishes).

SGE.name: Kerachole
SGE.note: Use your 30s mitigation for the first Mystery Magic after the Graven Image castbar. All mechanics require shields.

P.name: Party Mit
P.note: Use your 90s party mitigation as Kefka re-centres to cast the first Graven Image (WAR/PLD can use after Revolting Ruin III finishes).

mechanics.name: Light of Judgment
mechanics.note: Use late into the castbar so it also covers Hyperdrive.

SCH.name: Seraphism
SCH.note: If you plan to use Dissipation in your opener, use it before Aetherflow. If you use the first Spreadlo earlier, you will get it back for the Double-Trouble Trap in the second Graven Image and be able to use Seraphism earlier/later.

WHM.name: Liturgy of the Bell
WHM.note: You can alternatively use Bell just before the first set of puddles which will provide an immediate heal when the second set of puddles occurs as the Bell will expire shortly after.

WHM.name: Assist Tanks
WHM.note: Provide single target mitigation and GCD shield both tanks in the phase transition for Ultimate Embrace. Also assist tanks with the last Ultimate Embrace.

AST.name: Assist Tanks
AST.note: Provide single target mitigation and GCD shield both tanks in the phase transition for Ultimate Embrace. Also assist tanks with the last Ultimate Embrace.

SCH.name: Spreadlo
SCH.note: Prepare Spreadlo either on the OT shortly beforehand or the MT during Ultimate Embrace to assist the tanks. All mechanics require shields.

SGE.name: Holos
SGE.note: Use Holos during the first Ultimate Embrace so it is back for Light of Judgement and provides mitigation to the tanks. Alternatively, you can use Holos for the Wings of Destruction + Ultimate Embrace. All mechanics require shields.

SGE.name: Holos
SGE.note: Use Holos during the first Ultimate Embrace so it is back for Light of Judgement and provides mitigation to the tanks. Alternatively, you can use Holos for the Wings of Destruction + Ultimate Embrace.

MT.name: Party Mit
MT.note: Use early to avoid shaking off mitigation if playing WAR.

MT.name: Reprisal
MT.note: If you are holding Exdeath instead of Chaos at the beginning, use Reprisal on both before The Decisive Battle finishes.

SCH.name: Sacred Soil
SCH.note: At the beginning of the phase, use 30s mitigation after (when the textbox disappears) Kefka says, "Oh! What other toys can I throw in here..." to get tank autos and the raidwide + an additional usage for Stray Flames/Tsunami. All mechanics require shields.

SGE.name: Kerachole
SGE.note: At the beginning of the phase, use 30s mitigation after (when the textbox disappears) Kefka says, "Oh! What other toys can I throw in here..." to get tank autos and the raidwide + an additional usage for Stray Flames/Tsunami. All mechanics require shields.

SCH.name: Spreadlo
SCH.note: Prepare immediately after Bowels of Agony.

SGE.name: Zoe Shields
SGE.note: Prepare immediately after Bowels of Agony.

SCH.name: Expedient
SCH.note: There is a very small period where you can cover both hits of Thunder III and the next Stray Flames/Tsumani, if you miss the timing, you can use it next GCD.

SGE.name: Holos
SGE.note: There is a very small period where you can cover both hits of Thunder III and the next Stray Flames/Tsumani, if you miss the timing, you can use it next GCD.

MT.name: LB3
MT.note: Use LB3 at the W of Vacuum Wave. Either tank can press it, discuss beforehand.

OT.name: LB3
OT.note: Use LB3 at the W of Vacuum Wave. Either tank can press it, discuss beforehand.

SCH.name: Spreadlo
SCH.note: Prepare Spreadlo on the tanks, prioritizing WAR > DRK > GNB/PLD.

mechanics.name: Accretions
mechanics.note: Non-healers should avoid using any healing abilities that may cause their Accretion to pop early such as Second Wind, Curing Waltz or Divine Veil. If both Accretions are activated in a short amount of time, it will cause a wipe. Healers will need to manage HP burst accordingly to ensure that Accretions are not popped together. The H1 and H2 can throw single target heals at whoever has the Accretion between them. If playing AST, I recommend popping Macrocosmos immediately for the top-up as this will also take care of the tanks. WHM can use Benediction (if not used earlier) to instantly pop the healer Accretion.

SGE.name: Philosophia
SGE.note: Philosophia should be used after both Accretions resolves to avoid accidentally popping both at the same time.

MT.name: Reprisal
MT.note: Shared MT/OT assignment in the source; coordinate which tank uses Reprisal.

OT.name: Reprisal
OT.note: Shared MT/OT assignment in the source; coordinate which tank uses Reprisal.

WHM.name: Temperance
WHM.note: If you are holding at the end of P3, you can send this for the 6th Tether set.

AST.name: Neutral Sect

SGE.name: Panhaima
SGE.note: If you are holding at the end of P3, you can send this for the 6th Tether set.

MT.name: Reprisal
MT.note: Use if holding Chaos, otherwise use at the beginning of P4 for autos.

OT.name: Reprisal
OT.note: Use if holding Chaos, otherwise use at the beginning of P4 for autos.

SCH.name: Seraphism
SCH.note: Seraphism can be shifted to P4 if you feel you have sufficient mitigation. Both healers should have instant cast heals prepared to top up the party between the first and second set of stomps.

SGE.name: Kerachole
SGE.note: Both healers should have instant cast heals prepared to top up the party between the first and second set of stomps.

scopedNote.text: Target your firewalled boss while the firewall is up. Targeted mitigation mostly covers tank autos and busters in this phase, not raidwides.

M2.name: Feint
M2.note: Use at the beginning of the phase for autos.

scopedNote.text: Targeted mitigation only works on Ultima Upsurge; other uses cover tank autos.
